templates.why_chosen: A single frame ties one packet's hardware pipeline to annotated P4 source code, a Cores diagram, and a Memory hierarchy via labelled C1, C2, Cb arrows, mixing code, diagram, and memory layout under one architecture.
templates.what_to_learn: Link annotated source-code lines to the specific execution units running them with small labelled arrows (C1, C2, Cb), and share one Memory box with explicit R, W, R&W arrows across foreground and background cores; strengthen the loose visual link this figure leaves between its top pipeline row and bottom detail row.
